newsitem.title: USA: Exploration has North Dakota oil flow.
newsitem.headline: Exploration has North Dakota oil flow.

text.p: Exploration Co said Monday a Bowman County, N.D., Red River well flowing at 263 barrels of oil per day is one of two producing wells the company has completed.
The other is a Maverick County, Texas, Glen Rose well that is flowing at a rate of 1.6 million cubic feet of gas per day.
The company said production from the wells is anticipated to increase Exploration's revenue by $1.5 million per year.

Exploration said the Sherry 1-16, a vertical well in Bowman County, has an initial production rate of 263 barrels of 32 degree gravity oil and five barrels of water per day from the Red River "D" formation between 9,614-9,667 feet.

The company said "We believe that the production will increase to over 400 barrels per day with the installation of the pumping unit that has been ordered." Exploration owns a 100 percent working interest in the well and anticipates that its yearly revenue should increase by over $1.0 million with the addition of this one well prior to the installation of the pumping equipment.

It said the Paloma 1-106, a vertical Glen Rose well in Maverick County, has been tested at a rate of 1,645,000 cubic feet of gas per day from perforations at 5,384-5,406 feet. The well produced 3.3 barrels of condensate and one barrel of water in addition to the natural gas.
Exploration owns a 60 percent interest in the well.

The compawny said it is drilling two additional Red River wells in Bowman County that should be completed within the next 30 days. It is also drilling a horizontal well in the Georgetown formation in Maverick County that should also be completed within the next 30 days.
